questions.stem: Why are polysaccharides like starch better for energy storage than glucose?

options.text: They are soluble and can be transported easily
They are insoluble so do not affect water potential in cells
They are sweet and provide quick energy
They contain more elements than glucose

questions.explanation: Polysaccharides like starch are insoluble, so they do not affect water potential in cells and will not move out of the cell by osmosis. This makes them ideal for compact energy storage.
